warnings: Gap: analytics/order-creation.md — No authorization policy is supplied for warehouse_operator; no authorization test or expected outcome was generated for that role.

requirements.text: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.
Each order line quantity is an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive; quantities 0 and 101 are rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.title: Create an order as sales_manager with boundary quantities 1 and 100
preconditions: An authenticated user with the sales_manager role is available.
The order-creation endpoint POST /api/v1/orders is available.
Valid order-line item identifiers are available.
test_data: Request body contains one valid order line with quantity 1.
Request body contains one valid order line with quantity 100.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders as the sales_manager using a valid order body whose line quantity is 1.
steps.expected_result: The response HTTP status is 201 and the response code is CREATED.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders as the sales_manager using a valid order body whose line quantity is 100.
steps.expected_result: The response HTTP status is 201 and the response code is CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Both inclusive boundary quantities create an order successfully with HTTP 201 and code CREATED.

test_cases.title: Reject a sales_manager order line with quantity 0
preconditions: An authenticated user with the sales_manager role is available.
The order-creation endpoint POST /api/v1/orders is available.
A valid order-line item identifier is available.
test_data: Request body contains one otherwise valid order line with quantity 0.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders as the sales_manager using the order body with quantity 0.
steps.expected_result: The response HTTP status is 422 and the response error code is QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 0 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Reject a sales_manager order line with quantity 101
preconditions: An authenticated user with the sales_manager role is available.
The order-creation endpoint POST /api/v1/orders is available.
A valid order-line item identifier is available.
test_data: Request body contains one otherwise valid order line with quantity 101.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders as the sales_manager using the order body with quantity 101.
steps.expected_result: The response HTTP status is 422 and the response error code is QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 101 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Deny order creation by viewer
preconditions: An authenticated user with the viewer role is available.
The order-creation endpoint POST /api/v1/orders is available.
A valid order body with a permitted quantity is available.
test_data: Request body contains one valid order line with quantity 1.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders as the viewer using the valid order body.
steps.expected_result: The response HTTP status is 403 and the response code is FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The viewer cannot create an order and receives HTTP 403 with code FORBIDDEN.
